en: Black-and-white view of a European town square with a large fountain and monument at the center. The monument consists of a tall pedestal with columns and a kneeling female archer statue drawing a bow on top. At the corners of the fountain base are sculpted deer. Surrounding the square are multi-story historic buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows; one building has a clock tower. A few people stand near the fountain, and shopfronts with signs line the background.
